variant: Linux apache2 (mod_php) -> /bin/sh -c from the PHP2Shell honeypot (A01 and B16), shaped as Sysmon for Linux EventID 1; out of scope for this Windows-only rule
source: derived from public honeypot evidence 0x4D31/honeypot-data (CC-BY-4.0), report https://github.com/0x4D31/honeypot-data/blob/main/reports/php2shell/2026-10-24-confirmed-rce.md, dataset https://github.com/0x4D31/honeypot-data/tree/main/reports/php2shell/2026-10-24-rce-evidence at commit 0b6a57491134c10f7cc5055999f1cb8b38c67546
field_mapping: Field-mapped from Tetragon process_exec records, not native Splunk Sysmon EventID 1 (Linux sysmon:linux shape) telemetry. ParentImage=parent.binary; Image=process.binary; CommandLine=process.binary+" "+process.arguments; host=node_name; User=www-data from uid 33. Only process_exec records with the case's shell or its descendants are included; kprobe socket records are omitted. Values are otherwise as published (attacker IPs as published; honeypot addresses are the publisher's TEST-NET aliases).
note: Real attacker activity expected to be MISSED by this rule: it reads Windows Sysmon only, excludes sourcetype=sysmon:linux, and matches php-cgi.exe/php.exe/w3wp.exe parents with cmd/powershell/pwsh children. Adding a Linux sourcetype needs Debarshi's approval and is not part of this change. Linux coverage is in DAC-MDE-0096 and DAC-CS-0245.
